workloadNotes: Registry-protocol sweep taken from the actual route tables: ping, web UI shell and its data endpoints, user creation + login (jsonwebtoken/htpasswd), package metadata and tarball fetch through the npmjs uplink, search, and the audit proxy. The e2e-cli suite was not used: it drives a real npm client, whose file accesses are npm’s, not the registry’s.

curve.detail: ping, web UI shell, package listing — 4/4 succeeded, 4/4 answered
auth (htpasswd + jwt), uplink metadata/tarball fetch, search, audit — 12/12 succeeded, 12/12 answered
